schemes.label: NIF / NIPC (Número de Identificação Fiscal / Número de Identificação de Pessoa Coletiva)

provenance.sourceText: Os nomes, firmas ou denominações sociais e a sede ou domicílio do fornecedor de bens ou prestador de serviços e do destinatário ou adquirente sujeito passivo do imposto, bem como os correspondentes números de identificação fiscal;

schemes.helpText: The same number serves as the NIF for a natural person and as the NIPC (Número de Identificação de Pessoa Coletiva) for a legal person — a single tax identifier per entity, universally assigned in Portugal (individuals and companies), regardless of actual VAT liability.
schemes.notes: Código do IVA (CIVA), text as served by the Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira (AT), art. 36.º n.º 5 alínea a) — PRIMARY TEXT, read directly on 2026-09-04 at https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/codigos_tributarios/civa_rep/Pages/iva36.aspx (static HTML page served by the AT, direct curl with no JavaScript). FRONT-LINE CLAUSE for the SUPPLIER: the text imposes « os correspondentes números de identificação fiscal » on the « fornecedor de bens ou prestador de serviços » WITH NO CONDITION WHATSOEVER — the seller must ALWAYS carry their NIF/NIPC on the fatura, hence `required: true`. IMPORTANT NUANCE FOR THE BUYER, not to be lost if this fact is ever promoted to an unqualified `required: true`: the same sentence qualifies the recipient with « e do destinatário ou adquirente SUJEITO PASSIVO DO IMPOSTO » — the qualifier « sujeito passivo » (taxable person) applies GRAMMATICALLY to the recipient/buyer, not to the supplier, which means the BUYER's NIF is front-line mandatory ONLY when the buyer is themselves a taxable person for VAT (typically B2B). REINFORCED, read the same day on the same page, by n.º 16 of the same article: « A indicação na fatura do número de identificação fiscal do adquirente ou destinatário não sujeito passivo é sempre obrigatória quando este o solicite. » — for a NON-taxable buyer (a private individual), the NIF is mandatory on the fatura ONLY WHEN REQUESTED by that buyer. This catalog models `required: true` / `appliesTo: 'BOTH'` at the level AT WHICH this fact is consumed by this product (country-identifiers.ts's own resolveRequiredIdentifiers: 'does this country require this identifier for a party of this type', not literally 'must this identifier ALWAYS appear on THIS SPECIFIC invoice') — the NIF/NIPC is, in practice, universally held and communicated by every company AND every private individual in Portugal (a generalized administrative precondition), which the front-line clause above for the supplier confirms without reservation; the conditional nuance on the non-taxable buyer's side (n.º 16) is documented here honestly rather than passed over in silence. FORMAT (the commonly reported figure of 9 digits): NOT CONFIRMED by a primary text in this task — no mention of a digit count found in the CIVA, the Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019, or the Portarias 195/2020/363/2010 read elsewhere (systematic grep for « dígitos »/« nove » across these texts, no result). The founding text usually cited for the creation of the NIF in Portugal is the Decreto-Lei n.º 463/79, de 30 de novembro — THIS ATTRIBUTION HAS NOT BEEN VERIFIED AGAINST THE PRIMARY TEXT by this task (diariodarepublica.pt serves this statute behind an OutSystems React SPA with no public API found in this session, and no static official mirror equivalent to info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt was located for this specific statute within the time available): it is this text, read as primary source, that would settle the exact format. No `pattern` field is therefore declared here, as a matter of discipline — an unsourced pattern under a 'legal' provenance would have been exactly the kind of fabricated fact this task forbids itself from producing.

schemes.label: Número de Identificação Fiscal para efeitos de IVA

provenance.sourceText: Beneficiam da isenção do imposto os sujeitos passivos com sede ou domicílio em território nacional que, não praticando operações de exportação ou atividades conexas, não tenham atingido, no ano civil anterior, um volume de negócios anual em território nacional superior a 15 000 €.

schemes.helpText: The Portuguese VAT number is, in common practice, the same NIF/NIPC (see LEGAL_ID above) prefixed with "PT" for intra-Community exchanges (VIES) — THIS EQUIVALENCE HAS NOT BEEN CONFIRMED by a front-line clause in the texts read by this task (see notes): treat it as an empirical convention, not as a sourced fact.
schemes.notes: Código do IVA (CIVA), art. 53.º n.º 1 (« Âmbito de aplicação no território nacional », heading amended by the Decreto-Lei n.º 35/2025, de 24 de março) — PRIMARY TEXT, read directly on 2026-09-04 at https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/codigos_tributarios/civa_rep/Pages/artigo-53-o-do-civa.aspx (same access method as LEGAL_ID above). A Portuguese taxable person whose previous calendar year's domestic turnover did NOT exceed €15,000 benefits from an ISENÇÃO (exemption) — the same structural reasoning as fr.json/at.json/ee.json/hr.json for this same case: a company under this threshold is simply not registered for VAT in the full sense and therefore has no active VAT number to carry on its invoices, hence `required: false`. ADJACENT DATED FINDING, not modeled here (outside the scope of this specific fact but worth noting): the same art. 53.º, n.os 2 to 6 (read the same day), sets up a EUROPEAN exemption scheme (stemming from EU directive 2020/285, transposed by the Decreto-Lei n.º 35/2025 reform) allowing a taxable person established in ANOTHER Member State to benefit from this SAME Portuguese exemption if their annual EU-wide turnover does not exceed €100,000 and they have obtained, in their Member State of establishment, an individual identification number carrying the SUFFIX "EX" — a recent scheme (2025) and distinct from the domestic clause above, not investigated further by this task. FORMAT (the equivalence to the NIF/NIPC prefixed "PT"): NOT CONFIRMED by a front-line clause equivalent to the Croatian čl. 77 st. 6 already established by this catalog (hr.json) — no text read by this task (CIVA art. 27.º to 35.º-A reviewed for the registration regime) explicitly states that the Portuguese VAT number IS the prefixed NIF/NIPC. It is a convention widely used in professional tooling (VIES validators, etc.) but it remains HERE an unsourced INFERENCE, documented honestly rather than declared as a verified fact — no `pattern` is therefore declared, by the same discipline as for LEGAL_ID above. What would settle this: a provision of the CIVA (or of the Decreto-Lei n.º 463/79 on the NIF itself) explicitly stating this equivalence, read as primary source.

notes: Portugal (2026-09-04). Two schemes, as with most countries in this catalog: the NIF/NIPC (LEGAL_ID, universal, front-line required for the seller) and the VAT number (VAT, not required below the €15,000/year exemption threshold). TWO PRIMARY/OFFICIAL SOURCES READ AS RAW TEXT (direct curl on the static HTML pages served by the Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira — AT — at info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt, never a fetch-summary): the Código do IVA (CIVA), art. 36.º (mandatory content of the fatura) and art. 53.º (small-business exemption regime, recently modernized by the Decreto-Lei n.º 35/2025). DISCIPLINE APPLIED HONESTLY: the exact FORMAT of both identifiers (number of digits of the NIF/NIPC, exact equivalence NIF=VAT number prefixed "PT") WAS NOT confirmed by a primary text within the time available to this task — the founding statute usually cited for the NIF (Decreto-Lei n.º 463/79, de 30 de novembro) is served by diariodarepublica.pt behind an OutSystems React SPA with no public API found in this session (see country-policy/data/pt.json's own file-level notes for this task's general access method), and no static official mirror equivalent to the one found for the CIVA/the Decreto-Lei n.º 28/2019/the invoicing Portarias was located for this specific statute. No `pattern` field is therefore declared for either scheme — a numeric regularity widely known elsewhere (professional usage/tooling), but not sourced by this task, is never promoted to a 'legal' fact or even declared as an unsourced regex. What would settle this: reaching the primary text of the Decreto-Lei n.º 463/79 (via a static mirror yet to be identified, or by working around the diariodarepublica.pt SPA through a method not yet found for this specific statute).
